title: Duplicate Order Records
description: Some retried mobile requests create two orders with the same client request ID.

nodes.text: Some retried mobile requests create two orders with the same client request ID.

actions.label: Compare request traces
actions.result: Duplicate pairs share a request ID and overlap within milliseconds on different instances.

actions.label: Disable client retries
actions.result: Duplicates fall, but transient failures now become lost purchases and server-side races remain possible.

nodes.text: The incident continues. Temporary relief did not address the underlying cause.
observations: Duplicates fall, but transient failures now become lost purchases and server-side races remain possible.
The team still needs a diagnosis.

actions.label: Compare request traces
actions.result: Duplicate pairs share a request ID and overlap within milliseconds on different instances.

nodes.text: The first evidence narrows the fault domain.
observations: Duplicate pairs share a request ID and overlap within milliseconds on different instances.

actions.label: Inspect transaction logic
actions.result: Both transactions observe no row before either insert commits; no unique constraint exists.

actions.label: Add idempotency constraint without verification
actions.result: The unverified change creates risk and the incident is escalated after the recovery window expires.

nodes.text: Evidence now supports a specific root cause.
observations: Both transactions observe no row before either insert commits; no unique constraint exists.

actions.label: Add idempotency constraint
actions.result: A unique constraint plus conflict handling makes concurrent retries return the original order.

nodes.text: Service indicators remain healthy through the observation window.
observations: A unique constraint plus conflict handling makes concurrent retries return the original order.

nodes.text: The response window closes with customer impact unresolved.
observations: The incident is handed to the next response team.

rootCause: A check-then-insert race lacked a unique idempotency constraint, allowing concurrent retries to commit duplicates.

review.explanation: A check-then-insert race lacked a unique idempotency constraint, allowing concurrent retries to commit duplicates.
learningNotes: Use evidence to narrow the fault domain before changing production.
Temporary symptom relief is not the same as removing a root cause.
